description: This script creates an admin user in the application's database for local development. It takes command-line arguments for email, name, and password hash, then inserts a new User record into the database if it does not already exist.

classes.name: User
classes.description: The user model representing user data stored in the database.

methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, initializes app context, checks for existing user, and creates a new admin user if none exists.
